### Contributing guidelines

- [x] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I have read [CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md](https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [x] I have updated 'mini.nvim' to latest version of the `main` branch

### Module(s)

mini.sessions

### Neovim version

0.12 (!at least latest Nightly build!)

### Description

After that latest neovim Update today, i'm sometimes getting a vim.schedule callback when switching between Sessions:
```
vim.schedule callback: ...nvimejeCEA/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:1683: Failed to delete autocmd
stack traceback:
        [C]: in function 'nvim_del_autocmd'
        ...nvimejeCEA/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:1683: in function 'cleanup_show_autocmd'
        ...nvimejeCEA/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:1817: in function 'hide'
        ...nvimejeCEA/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:2263: in function 'hide'
        ...nvimejeCEA/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:2331: in function 'show'
        ...nvimejeCEA/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/lsp/client.lua:1129: in function <...nvimejeCEA/usr/share/nvi
m/runtime/lua/vim/lsp/client.lua:1124>
```


### Reproduction

I needed to add some LSP Setup to reproduce the error:
``` lua
-- Clone latest 'mini.nvim' (requires Git CLI installed)
vim.cmd('echo "Installing `mini.nvim`" | redraw')
local mini_path = vim.fn.stdpath('data') .. '/site/pack/deps/start/mini.nvim'
local clone_cmd = { 'git', 'clone', '--depth=1', 'https://github.com/nvim-mini/mini.nvim', mini_path }
vim.fn.system(clone_cmd)
vim.cmd('echo "`mini.nvim` is installed" | redraw')

-- Make sure 'mini.nvim' is available
vim.cmd('packadd mini.nvim')
require('mini.deps').setup()
require("mini.sessions").setup({
  autowrite = true,
})

vim.pack.add({
  'https://github.com/neovim/nvim-lspconfig',
  'https://github.com/mason-org/mason-lspconfig.nvim',
  'https://github.com/mason-org/mason.nvim',
  'https://github.com/WhoIsSethDaniel/mason-tool-installer.nvim',
})

require('mason').setup()
require("mason-lspconfig").setup()

require('mason-tool-installer').setup {

  -- a list of all tools you want to ensure are installed upon
  -- start
  ensure_installed = {
    "lua_ls",
    "ansiblels",
    "ansible-lint",
  },
}

vim.lsp.config('ansiblels', {
  filetypes = { 'yaml' },
})

vim.lsp.config('lua_ls', {
  on_init = function(client)
    if client.workspace_folders then
      local path = client.workspace_folders[1].name
      if
          path ~= vim.fn.stdpath('config')
          and (vim.uv.fs_stat(path .. '/.luarc.json') or vim.uv.fs_stat(path .. '/.luarc.jsonc'))
      then
        return
      end
    end

    client.config.settings.Lua = vim.tbl_deep_extend('force', client.config.settings.Lua, {
      runtime = {
        -- Tell the language server which version of Lua you're using (most
        -- likely LuaJIT in the case of Neovim)
        version = 'LuaJIT',
        -- Tell the language server how to find Lua modules same way as Neovim
        -- (see `:h lua-module-load`)
        path = {
          'lua/?.lua',
          'lua/?/init.lua',
        },
      },
      -- Make the server aware of Neovim runtime files
      workspace = {
        checkThirdParty = false,
        library = {
          vim.env.VIMRUNTIME
        }
      }
    })
  end,
  settings = {
    Lua = {}
  }
})
```
With this setup, i create a Session in my Neovim config folder and another one in an ansible repo. When switching from the ansible session to the neovim session, i get the error above or something like this:
```
vim.schedule callback: ...nvimKBiPcL/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:1683: Failed to delete autocmd
stack traceback:
        [C]: in function 'nvim_del_autocmd'
        ...nvimKBiPcL/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:1683: in function 'cleanup_show_autocmd'
        ...nvimKBiPcL/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:1759: in function 'hide'
        ...nvimKBiPcL/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:2263: in function 'hide'
        ...nvimKBiPcL/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:2331: in function 'show'
        ...nvimKBiPcL/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/diagnostic.lua:1405: in function 'set'
        ...KBiPcL/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/lsp/diagnostic.lua:241: in function 'handle_diagnostics'
        ...KBiPcL/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/lsp/diagnostic.lua:252: in function 'handler'
        ...nvimKBiPcL/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/lsp/client.lua:1238: in function '_notification'
        ...nvimKBiPcL/usr/share/nvim/runtime/lua/vim/lsp/client.lua:459: in function ''
        vim/_core/editor.lua: in function <vim/_core/editor.lua:0>
```
This doesn't happen on every project switch, but when it happend, i also get the error on Switching Buffers.

comment_data.body:
Thanks for the issue!

I didn't encounter this myself with my current sessions (on recent Nightly). And I am having trouble reproducing this since I am not really familiar with Ansible. Could you please elaborate with the following info:

- How do you switch between session?
- How do you create 'mini.sessions' sessions? Are they global or local?
- What exactly are the buffers opened when writing those sessions?
- Could you provide a very minimal example of Ansible project for which it would be reproducible to create a session?

Basically, everything covered by "With this setup, i create a Session in my Neovim config folder and another one in an ansible repo. When switching from the ansible session to the neovim session" but in more detail for a person that doesn't know how to work win Ansible.

I did not encounter this error during all this time. I also tried to reproduce it with the provided repro:
- Installed `ansible`.
- Cloned [geerlingguy/ansible-for-devops](https://github.com/geerlingguy/ansible-for-devops).
- Created a session for the Neovim config and with 'playbooks/deploy.yml' from [`deployments`](https://github.com/geerlingguy/ansible-for-devops/tree/master/deployments) example.
- Switched between two session multiple times with `:lua MiniSessions.select()`. No errors.

So I am going to close this, at least for now. If there emerges a more reliable way of reproducing this, feel free to add a comment. However, since the error traceback doesn't really mention 'mini.nvim', my guess is that it would be possible to reproduce without 'mini.sessions' (with plain `:mksession` and `:source` probably).

title: [mini.sessions] Failed to delete autocmd on Session Switching (sometimes)
